python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, re, collections
for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('system-spec').rglob('*.md')):
    t=p.read_text()
    heads=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.startswith('## ') or l.startswith('### ')]
    routes=collections.Counter(re.findall(r'設計解釈の記録経路: `([^`]+)`',t))
    adopt=collections.Counter(re.findall(r'採否: `([^`]+)`',t))
    nature=collections.Counter(re.findall(r'根拠の性質: ([^/)]+)',t))
    print('=====',p, dict(routes), dict(adopt))
    print('  nature:',{k.strip()[:40]:v for k,v in nature.items()})
    print('  heads:',heads)
PY
